title: Casio Digital Men Watch WS-1800-3AVDF
description:
A multifunctional digital watch with wide, easy-read display — perfect for the sports scene.

The retro-style large graphic display makes the countdown timer easy to read at a glance. Water-resistant up to 100 meters, ten-year battery life, LED backlight, as well as handy features like stopwatch, alarm, and more.
features: World time: World time 29 time zones (48 cities), city code display, daylight saving on/off
Timer: Measuring unit- 1 second Preset start times: 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45 minutes
Timers Up to nine timers can be preset with separate starting times for timing of intervals.
Mute feature: Button operation tone on/off
12/24-hour format -Regular timekeeping: Hour, minute, second, pm, month, date, day
